correctness.rationale: An invariant line meets the intersection of three unit disks in the intersection of their exact chord intervals. In each 60-degree normal sector t=0 has length one. For L>1-ε all offsets obey |t|<=sqrt(2ε); the angular strips of width O(sqrt ε) contribute O(ε). For the interior angles the active endpoint expansion gives q_ε(α)=ε cot α+O(ε² cot³ α), whose integrated error is O(ε); each angular sector has measure ε log(1/ε)+O(ε), with total line mass π, yielding 3/π. Independent exact disk-intersection numerical quadratures across ε=1e-3,1e-4,1e-5 yield finite-difference coefficient approaching 0.9549297. Finite checks do not establish uniform asymptotics.
